checks.name: V01 Valid native save still succeeds through the stricter review source
V02 Confirmed save appears exactly once in the actual calendar
V03 Native archive has one card and never receives writing
V04 Native private detail reads writing and the saved tag
V05 Actual navigation hides offline detail writing and tags
V06 Another native editor sees the confirmed first version
V07 Editing while detail is hidden advances only to version two
V08 Source notifications cannot repaint the hidden offline detail
V09 Returning detail rereads the current writing and version
V10 Confirmed delete returns to a missing detail with no old writing
V11 Archive removes the deleted card without inventing an empty body
V12 Calendar remains empty after the same deletion
V13 Validated review still makes no real cloud initialization

compatibility.savedEntries: Full required record fields, unique date/ID and projection required
